displayTitle: The Man’s Daughter and the Wife’s Daughter
description: The man’s daughter must spin stiff pig’s bristles against her stepsister’s soft flax, and whoever’s thread breaks first goes down the well. A Norwegian fairy tale of talking animals and a troll-wife, in plain modern English.
summary: Sent down a well, a kind stepdaughter serves a troll-wife and comes home with a chest of gold, so her lazy stepsister wants one too.
